notes.title: 2.1 Update
notes.content:
・Attack direction can now be changed without locking on
・Dodge direction can now be changed without locking on
・Added stagger effect to certain enemies
・Various balance adjustments and minor tweaks

notes.title: 2.0 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed the issue where the paper count would display as 0 upon acquisition—this time for real
・Fixed the issue where offering a charm to the lantern would not increase the count—this time for real
・Other minor adjustments

notes.title: 1.9 Update
notes.content:
・Modified the tutorial so that only one talisman can be selected during talisman creation
・Reduced the enemy's health in the tutorial
・Adjusted the presentation of certain cutscenes
・Fixed an issue where sound would continuously play during some horror effects
・After the ending has finished playing, automatically return to the title screen
・Fix the issue where voice lines continue to play when opening the menu during dialogue
・Made minor adjustments and refinements

notes.title: 1.8 Update
notes.content:
• Increased attack speed and dodge speed
• Increased stamina recovery speed
• Added invincibility frames to the lightning talisman
• Enhanced area attack talisman (increased damage and hit range)
• Fixed an issue where offering talismans to lanterns did not increase their count
• Fixed a bug where the paper crafting material would display as zero despite being obtained
• Extended lock-on range
• Fixed an issue where only forward rolls were possible while locked on
• Other adjustments

notes.title: 1.7 Update
notes.content:
・Improved visibility in certain stages
・Added horror effects
・Adjusted to increase lock-on range

notes.title: 1.6 Update
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where some enemies would slack off when you have low demon power
・Other minor adjustments

notes.title: 1.5 Update
